preserved: For PNG JPEG GIF or WebP with a supported decoder, rendered visible pixels including per-pixel alpha are morphologically equivalent inside the resolved image box; data-URL spelling, base64 text, compression and encoded bytes are not compared
violated: Any visible color, shape, frame selection or alpha differs, is replaced, or disappears inside the resolved image box
unknown: The media kind is ambiguous, decoding or rendering is unsupported, or the observation cannot distinguish pixels and alpha; Unknown never counts as Preserved

preserved: The rendered image occupies the finite resolved page-space x, y, width and height supplied by layout
violated: The rendered origin or physical extent differs observably, including a second layout or intrinsic-size adjustment
unknown: Any required position or dimension is absent, non-finite, or cannot be measured by the oracle

preserved: The visible stretch, contain or cover result already encoded by the resolved box and fit carriers is preserved without recomputing layout; preserveAspectRatio attribute spelling is not an observable
violated: The exporter introduces a different fit policy, intrinsic-ratio adjustment, distortion or crop from the resolved result
unknown: The fit carrier, intrinsic dimensions or landmarks needed to distinguish the intended morphology are unavailable

preserved: For an asymmetric landmark image, EXIF orientation 1 through 8 is reflected exactly once in the visible result over the resolved box; matrix spelling is not compared
violated: Orientation is ignored, mapped to the wrong case, or applied more than once
unknown: The orientation carrier is absent or invalid, or the selected image and renderer cannot discriminate the orientation

preserved: For a finite valid clip_rect, only the intersection with the resolved page-space clip is visible and cover overflow is hidden, without rebaking position, fit or orientation
violated: Pixels outside clip_rect remain visible, pixels inside are incorrectly removed, or clip position or size is transformed twice
unknown: The clip carrier is absent when required, malformed or non-finite, or clipping cannot be observed independently

preserved: For finite self-contained SVG bytes conservatively identified from the first significant XML element, nested visible shapes, text landmarks, colors and alpha survive as one image resource in the resolved box; internal IDs, markup, scripts, data-URL spelling, base64 and bytes are not compared
violated: Any required nested landmark, color or alpha disappears, changes visibly, escapes its box, or the resource is flattened in a way that changes morphology
unknown: The root is ambiguous or unsupported, compressed, externally dependent, non-finite, or cannot be parsed or rendered by the oracle; no claim is inferred from mere MIME or payload presence

preserved: The embedded resource declares the MIME coherent with its represented supported kind: image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, image/webp or conservatively identified image/svg+xml, and the resource resolves to that kind
violated: A supported image is labeled as another kind, a fabricated MIME is used, or the declared kind cannot decode to the represented resource
unknown: The kind is unsupported or ambiguous, including bytes for which a conservative SVG-root check cannot decide; byte-for-byte payload identity is outside this observable

preserved: Unsupported or ambiguous image bytes emit a non-visual diagnostic marker data-crystalline-image-fallback="unknown-format", emit no image resource, invent no MIME, and receive the verdict Unknown rather than a preservation claim
violated: Unknown bytes are silently omitted without the diagnostic marker, emitted as an image under an invented kind, or classified Preserved
unknown: This observable is canonically Unknown whenever the fallback contract is followed; Unknown withholds every visible-content claim and is never promoted to Preserved by default
